text:
maria_cs: Hey team — quick wrap from Rainfield's private deploy dry run this morning. Sharing a short list of open asks before we close week0.

sam_customer: Thanks, Maria. Appreciate the run. Main blocker for us is the KMS rotation window — we can't risk a rotation during our cutover.

maria_cs: Understood. Devon, Alex — can we add a KMS freeze window to the runbook and confirm who will ack it? Also need CloudTrail export confirmation for audit logs.

alex_infra: Yep, we can add a freeze. Proposed: freeze from 2026-04-06T00:00Z -> 2026-04-09T00:00Z (72h). That aligns with Rainfield's maintenance window. @sam_customer is that ok? :calendar: 

sam_customer: That works. We'll avoid any key material changes during that period.

devon_sre: Adding to runbook now. Quick note on network: we saw two rejected flows from their egress IP range to our mgmt plane — looks like a firewall rule mismatch. Need their egress CIDR and port list for the connector.

sam_customer: Egress CIDR is 10.240.32.0/21 and they will use ports 443, 22 for the initial setup, 443 only for runtime.

alex_infra: Got it. I'll add the CIDR to the allowlist. Also double-checked the VPC peering route table — we need them to advertise 10.240.32.0/21 on their side or peering won't propagate.

maria_cs: Logging: audit retention requirement is 365 days. We proposed forwarding CloudTrail -> customer SIEM via S3 (bucket encrypted SSE-KMS with our key). Sam, confirm SIEM integration SLA for delivery.

sam_customer: SIEM can ingest within 30 mins. Can you confirm that logs are delivered encrypted with our key? We have compliance that requires customer-managed KMS.

alex_infra: Two options: 1) Use their customer-managed key (preferred) and grant our redwood-service role Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, or 2) use our key but set a cross-account grant. Sam, we prefer option 1 for compliance.

sam_customer: Option 1 please. We'll share the key ARN and minimal IAM policy.

maria_cs: Perfect. Devon — can you paste the IAM snippet we'll need to give them so they can create the key policy?

devon_sre: Sure — sample policy below (they should scope Principals to the redwood servicerole ARN):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-servicerole"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

alex_infra: I'll validate cross-account access after they post the key ARN. Also we need: 1) S3 bucket policy to allow putObject from CloudTrail, 2) ensure S3 SSE-KMS key is used for encryption.

OnboardBot: Checklist update: KMS key ARN pending from customer, CloudTrail bucket created (dev), Firewall rule update pending, Runbook updated with KMS freeze window.

maria_cs: Renewal risk note — Rainfield flagged potential budget headwinds next quarter. If cutover slips >2 weeks we'll surface to AM for renewal conversation. For now, aim to keep the timeline.

sam_customer: Noted. We'll prioritize the freeze window and key share.

devon_sre: Action items: (1) Alex to add CIDR allowlist + peering check (ETA 2h), (2) Sam to share KMS ARN + minimal key policy (ETA EOD), (3) Maria to escalate renewal watch to AM if cutover moves.

alex_infra: Started on CIDR/peering. Will post console screenshots once routes propagate.

sam_customer: I'll DM the key ARN and the SIEM contact. Thanks all. :pray:

maria_cs: Thanks everyone — next check-in tomorrow 09:30 PT. If anything blocks earlier ping in this thread. :thumbsup:
